biometric_invalidated: Ukukhiya isikrini sedivayisi yakho kushintshile, ngakho uhlelo lokusebenza alusakwazi ukuvulwa lapha. Faka kabusha futhi ubuyisele isikhwama ngasinye kusuka emushweni waso wokubuyisela.
create_passphrase_hint: "Igama lama-25" — imfihlo eyengeziwe, engagcinwa. Uma ulisetha, udinga umusho nalokhu ukuze ubuyisele. Shiya kungenalutho uma ungaqinisekile.
create_phrase_body: Bhala la magama angu-%1$d ephepheni, ungaxhunywe ku-inthanethi. Noma ubani onawo ulawula izimali zakho.
dialog_remove_body: Lokhu kususa isikhwama kulolu hlelo lokusebenza kuphela. Akukho okushintshayo ku-blockchain, futhi ungasengeza kabusha noma nini ngomusho waso wokubuyisela (nomushwana wokungena, uma usethile owodwa). Qiniseka ukuthi umusho ubhalwe phansi.
dialog_reveal_body: Umusho wokubuyisela (nomushwana wokungena, uma usethile owodwa) uyinto kuphela engabuyisela lesi sikhwama — futhi noma ubani onawo angasebenzisa izimali zakho. Wembule kuphela endaweni eyimfihlo, kungekho muntu obukayo. Isikrini esilandelayo sivimba izithombe-skrini.
error_wallet_max: Ungagcina izikhwama ezifika ku-%1$d kudivayisi eyodwa.
gen_body: Ifoni yakho isivele idale imbewu ephephile. Yinyakazise — noma udwebe kuphedi — ukuze uhlanganise i-entropy eyengeziwe kusuka kuzinzwa zokunyakaza nokuguquguquka kwesikhathi. Ngenxa yokuqapha.
gen_entropy_full: i-entropy eyengeziwe eminingi — imbewu eyisisekelo isivele iphephile
gen_words_hint: Kokubili kuphephile; angu-12 kulula ukuwabhala phansi.
history_hint: thepha isenzo ukuze usivule kusiphenyi · cindezela isikhathi eside ukuze ukopishe i-id
lock_choice_biometric_note: Ukuvula okukodwa kuvula zonke izikhwama zakho. Ayikho iphasiwedi ozoyikhumbula — isigxivizo somunwe/ubuso bedivayisi yakho noma i-PIN yokukhiya isikrini iyakungenisa.
lock_choice_password_note: Le phasiwedi ivula uhlelo lokusebenza nesikhwama ngasinye kulo.
lock_choice_use_biometric: Khiya uhlelo lokusebenza ngesigxivizo somunwe noma i-PIN
onboard_tagline: isikhwama esingagcinwa se-Bitcoin XBT ne-Bitcoin BTC
restore_body: Faka amagama akho angu-12 noma angu-24, ehlukaniswe ngezikhala.
restore_clone_hint: Ngemva kokwengezwa ungabuye ufake lesi sikhwama ku-%1$s kusuka ku-Phatha izikhwama — umusho ofanayo, amakheli afanayo.
reveal_failed: Ayikwazanga ukususa umbhalo ocashile kulesi sikhwama.
reveal_no_passphrase: Awukho umushwana wokungena we-BIP-39 kulesi sikhwama.
reveal_warning: Noma ubani obona la magama — kanye nomushwana wokungena, uma usethiwe — angasebenzisa lesi sikhwama. Wabuke kuphela endaweni eyimfihlo. Ungalokothi uwathayiphe kuwebhusayithi noma kuhlelo lokusebenza. Izithombe-skrini zivinjelwe lapha.
send_replay_note: Yengeza imali engu-~110 vB. Akujwayelekile ku-relay ezenzakalelayo ye-Bitcoin — sakaza ngenodi/isevisi eyamukela ama-OP_RETURN amakhulu.
send_replay_protect: Ukuvikela ukudlala kabusha kwe-XBT (i-OP_RETURN yamabhayithi angu-100)
send_service_fee: Imali yesevisi: %1$s%% yenani elithunyelwe (okuncane %2$d sat) — isekela le nodi ebanjiwe.
settings_degraded_note: Isevisi ye-fortis ayifinyeleleki — isebenzisa idatha yebhulokhi yomphakathi okwamanje. Izobuyela ngokuzenzakalelayo.
settings_one_unlock: Ukuvula okukodwa kuvula isikhwama ngasinye ohlelweni lokusebenza.
